description: Verify a signed Certification (halal, kosher, vegetarian, ...; RFC-0010): the authority signature against the KeyRecords you trust, the subject hash, status and validity window. Give certification_id (from the catalog) or a certification object, and keys or keys_path. There is no default trust list: keys_path /v1/conformance/keys/certification-test-keys.json holds only the public test keys of the fictional example authorities.

certification.description: A certification document, instead of certification_id

keys.description: KeyRecords of the authorities you trust

keys_path.description: A KeyRecord list published on the catalog, for example /v1/conformance/keys/certification-test-keys.json

recipe_id.description: Alternative to subject_hash: use this catalog recipe's hash

subject_hash.description: Hash of the recipe revision you hold; omit to skip the subject check

name: verify_certification
title: Verify a certification
